name: Passage to Booty Bay
summary: Wharfmaster Dizzywig’s records send the search for Velinde Starsong from Ratchet to Booty Bay. From there, Alliance travelers seek Ruzzgot, a goblin caravan driver.

sections.title: A Trail Across the Sea
sections.body: Wharfmaster Dizzywig’s records carry the search for night elf Sentinel Velinde Starsong from Ashenvale to the sea. In Ratchet, the goblin port, Dizzywig finds old shipping manifests showing that Velinde booked passage on the Black Osprey. The vessel was bound for Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale.

sections.title: The Road to Booty Bay
sections.body: A neutral goblin ferry crosses the Great Sea between Ratchet and the southern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms. In Booty Bay, the trail leads to Caravaneer Ruzzgot, a goblin transport master Dizzywig recommended to Velinde. She had asked about dangerous overland journeys through the southern wilderness.

faq.answer: Velinde Starsong was a night elf priestess who led efforts to hold back the demonic presence in Felwood. Her efforts faltered, and she disappeared. The Sentinels are tracing her journey across the sea.

faq.q: Why did Velinde travel to Booty Bay?
aliases: why did she go to booty bay
faq.answer: Velinde traveled to Booty Bay to seek passage across the Great Sea. The Black Osprey sailed from Ratchet to Booty Bay, where she asked about overland travel toward the human and dwarven kingdoms.

Wharfmaster Dizzywig manages Ratchet’s shipping docks for the Steamwheedle Cartel. Impatient by nature, he keeps logbooks and passage manifests for vessels traveling between Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms.
Caravaneer Ruzzgot is a goblin teamster based in Booty Bay. He coordinates supply convoys and overland transport through the dangerous jungles of Stranglethorn Vale and beyond.
Wharfmaster Dizzywig’s shipping records show that Velinde Starsong booked passage aboard the Black Osprey. The ship sailed from Ratchet across the Great Sea to Booty Bay.

faq.q: How do I travel to Booty Bay from Ratchet?
aliases: how to get to booty bay
faq.answer: The Steamwheedle Cartel runs a passenger ferry from Ratchet’s southern dock across the Great Sea. It docks at Booty Bay on the southern tip of Stranglethorn Vale.

angles.text: As a Kaldorei, you have urgent reason to find Velinde Starsong. She disappeared with the Scythe of Elune, leaving a dangerous mystery in Ashenvale’s forests.
As an Alliance traveler, you need patience and diplomacy in neutral goblin ports like Ratchet and Booty Bay. Mercenaries and cartel bureaucrats are part of the way.
